one_month_reasoning: Qualcomm's fiscal Q4 FY26 report is expected in early-to-mid November (MarketBeat lists Nov 11), i.e. outside the Oct 30 window, so no company earnings fall inside it. In-window items are second-order: Samsung preliminary Q3 results (early Oct), TSMC Q3 results (mid-Oct), Apple's FQ4 report around the end of October (iPhone 18 build/modem commentary), iPhone 18 teardowns confirming Qualcomm's reduced modem share, CPI and the late-October FOMC. The stock just fell ~9% in two sessions (from $201.97 on Sep 25/27 to $184.47) after a September rally on the Amazon deal and Apple license renewal; short-horizon reversal and continued profit-taking roughly offset, and the Sep 29 downgrade plus 10b5-1 insider sales are known. I therefore use a near-symmetric lognormal centred at ~$184 with ~14% monthly sigma (slightly below 54%/3.5 because no earnings print is in the window).

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (NTM EPS at Sep-2027 of ~$10.75 x 15x = $161, weight 0.6) and FCF yield (FY27 FCF ~$9.0B / ~1.08B diluted shares = $8.33/share at a 5% yield = $167, weight 0.4); skeptic haircuts to consensus for the Apple modem cliff, memory-driven handset weakness and QCT margin compression.

bear.story: Memory crunch persists through 2027 and OEMs keep down-specing to prior-gen chips; Apple modem revenue collapses toward ~$1-2B; QCT margins stay in low-20s; data center revenue is lumpy and the flagship chips slip to 2028+. FY27 EPS ~$9.3, stock de-rates to ~13x = ~$120.

base.story: FY27 EPS ~$10.2 (below consensus $10.84) with a handset trough mid-2027; auto and IoT grow, Amazon/data-center revenue starts but is small; NTM EPS ~$10.9 at ~16x = ~$175.

bull.story: Handset trough passes with price increases restoring margins, Amazon/hyperscaler custom silicon ramps visibly, non-handset growth >60% as guided; market pays ~20x on ~$12.5 forward EPS = ~$250, retesting the 52-week high.

thesis_break_reason: Below the $121.99 52-week low and ~11x consensus FY27 EPS; trading there would most likely mean earnings are heading toward ~$9 or lower (handset decline deepening beyond the Apple cliff, QCT margin below 23%, or the Amazon/data-center ramp slipping), not ordinary volatility.

reasoning: Skeptic lane. Hard facts: Q3 FY26 handsets -20% y/y to $5.1B, QTL -3%, auto +61%; Q4 guide $9.7-10.5B / EPS $2.05-2.25 with QCT EBT margin falling to 23-25% on memory/wafer/packaging costs (sources 1, 8). Apple's iPhone 18 modem share came in materially below 20%, with Apple chip revenue ~halving into the Dec quarter (5). Estimates are drifting down (FY27 consensus $10.84; normalized NTM $9.30 from $9.80) (6, 7), Zacks Rank moved to Strong Sell, a Sep-29 Buy-to-Hold downgrade calls the $18 EPS/2029 target best-case (2), JPMorgan was at Neutral with a $140 target in April (3), and the CEO and CFO sold under 10b5-1 plans in September (9, 10) - weak signals on their own. Dilution: ~19M shares for a software deal and up to $4B of Amazon warrants (4, 11). Offsets I weigh honestly: A2 credit and modest leverage (13), Apple license renewed from Apr-2027 (12), Amazon's up-to-$60B multi-generation commitment and a raised $7B auto run-rate (1, 11), and Arm largely lost at trial (15). I found no short-seller report or accounting red flag. Net: stock at ~17x a consensus I think is 5-6% too high, so fair value ~$165 (P/E 161, FCF 167), about 10% below the price. Scenario mean ~$177 with dividend ~2%. For the distribution I centre the median at ~$174 and use ~42% log-sigma (below the 54% realized, which was inflated by event-driven swings, but above a typical large cap given the binary data-center story), giving P(>= today's $184) ~45%. Research limited: Alpha Vantage rate-limited and Twelve Data price targets paywalled; several paywalled pages (Seeking Alpha news, BofA note) read only via summaries.
